headline: OJK Speaks Out on Fate of Banks Failing to Meet Capital Requirements in 2027
summary: The OJK is encouraging bank consolidation to strengthen structure and capital. It says the policy aims to create more efficient banks, in relation to banks that fail to meet capital requirements in 2027.
why: Capital requirements set by Indonesia's financial regulator determine whether smaller lenders must merge or raise capital, which affects bank valuations and consolidation activity.
original_headline: OJK Buka Suara soal Nasib Bank yang Gagal Penuhi Syarat Modal di 2027
